stemMd: A constant net force of 15 N acts on a cart for 0.4 s. What change in momentum does it produce?
explanationMd: Impulse equals force times time and equals change in momentum. Multiplying 15 by 0.4 gives 6 N s, equivalent to 6 kg m/s.
